history.name: One open release, and everything lands on it
history.description: There is always exactly one release in progress at the end of the timeline, and every entry written goes onto it. Nobody has to say which version a piece of work belongs to, and work can't be recorded against something already presented to a client — if the last release has shipped, the tool says to open the next one first.
history.dev_notes: Project#workingVersion; ReleaseSet enforces at most one future release and that it is last.
